section_summary.extract_value: This procedural section describes opportunistic recruitment of participants at campus locations who completed a five-page questionnaire individually and anonymously after providing informed consent. Participants were voluntary, not paid, and were verbally debriefed upon returning the questionnaire. The section does not report sample size, demographics, instruments (BAS/BAS-2), BMI assessment, or statistical results.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Once ethical approval for the study was obtained from the relevant university ethics committee, participants were recruited on an opportunistic basis... Once participants provided informed consent, they were provided with a five-page questionnaire, which they completed anonymously and individually... All participants took part on a voluntary basis and were not remunerated for their participation. Once they returned their questionnaire to the experimenter, they were verbally debriefed."
